nodes.description: Biallelic hypomorphic EXOC7 variants reduce functional Exo70. The best characterised allele, c.809-2A>G, halves EXOC7 protein. Exo70 is the exocyst subunit that binds phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate at the plasma membrane, and its N-terminal region, where Ser48 lies, binds EXOC8. Both activities are reduced when the protein is reduced; which of them each missense or in-frame allele impairs has not been measured.

nodes.description: In mammalian cells the Exo70-PI(4,5)P2 interaction is needed for the exocyst to reach the plasma membrane and for post-Golgi vesicles to dock and fuse. Neither process has been measured in patient cells or in the zebrafish model.
